title: Pizza with pepperoni, from frozen, medium crust

content.title: About
content.content: Pizza with pepperoni is a ready‑to‑bake frozen product consisting of a medium‑thick crust, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and pepperoni slices. Designed for quick oven preparation, it provides a flavorful and satisfying meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pepperoni is an American version of Italian salami that became popular in the US in the 1950s.
Flash freezing preserves the taste and texture of the ingredients.
A medium crust offers a balance between a crisp base and a soft interior.
The tomato sauce is typically made from ripe tomatoes, basil, and oregano for a classic aroma.
Pepperoni pizza is often considered comfort food and is a common late‑night order.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Cheese and pepperoni provide a notable amount of protein, essential for tissue repair.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Mozzarella supplies calcium, supporting bone and tooth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Tomatoes and pepperoni contain vitamins B6 and B12, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Lycopene in sauce
items.content: Tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, an antioxidant that helps protect cells.

items.title: Satiety
items.content: The combination of carbs, fats, and protein makes the pizza filling and helps maintain fullness longer.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Cheese and pepperoni can be salty, which may be unsuitable for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Pepperoni and cheese contain saturated fats, which should be limited in heart‑related conditions.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: People allergic to dairy proteins should avoid this pizza.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: The crust contains wheat, making it unsuitable for a gluten‑free diet.

content.title: How to Cook
content.content: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (392 °F). Place the pizza on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12‑15 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted. Let it cool briefly before slicing.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen pizza in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After thawing, use within 24 hours. Do not store at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
